name: March of the Valkyr grants a raid-wide 3% damage aura and 5% parry (#756)
contract: March of the Valkyr 560534 is family 33, Attributes 64 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) with EquippedItemClass -1 and no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) targeting TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (1) with EffectRadiusIndex 287 and ApplyAuraName SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79), EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3; Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura is the native, generic handler for effect 65 and is already used by many other raid-wide buffs, spreading a linked aura instance of the same spell to every raid member within radius. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT (47) on the caster only (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, it does not spread with the raid aura), EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5, a plain native stat aura, confirmed independently of the stat gate by the aura_amount assertion below. Neither effect needs a script: this is not "no server-side implementation". melee_damage_done queries player->MeleeDamageBonusDone(target, 1000, ...), which folds SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE into DoneTotalMod, so a fresh fixture with no other percent-damage modifiers goes from 1000 to exactly 1030 once it holds the spread aura. parry_chance is not a plain passthrough of the aura: Player::UpdateParryPercentage (StatSystem.cpp) only runs its nondiminishing/diminishing calculation when CanParry() is true, and that calculation always adds a nondiminishing 5.0f base term on top of any SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT amount. A fresh Sun Cleric never satisfies CanParry() (it starts false and nothing else in this scenario sets it), so 'control' reads exactly 0 -- not because the class is penalized, but because the whole calculation is gated off. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModParryPercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) flips CanParry() to true as a side effect of applying ANY SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT aura (stock, class-agnostic core behavior, not a Sun Cleric special case), so the instant 'talent' learns March of the Valkyr it both gains the aura's own +5 and un-gates the base +5 in the same recalculation, landing on 10, not 5. The 5-vs-10 split cannot be told apart by a delta against a 'control' that never reaches CanParry()==true; it is only provable by reading the aura's own resolved amount (aura_amount, unaffected by the stat gate) separately from the final gated stat, and by asserting the gated stat's absolute value as base + aura.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
A Sun Cleric with no parry-granting aura never satisfies CanParry(), so the gated stat stays 0
The nearby grouped ally receives the same aura
The aura's own parry effect resolves to 5 (EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1), independent of the CanParry gate
Learning the talent flips CanParry() true, so the real parry stat becomes the 5.0 nondiminishing base plus the aura's 5, landing on 10
The grouped ally's damage rises by 3% from the spread aura
